launchFields.main_profile_id: Required profile selected as the player-controlled character.
launchFields.ai_teammate_enabled: True only when a distinct teammate profile is selected and the feature is enabled.
launchFields.ai_teammate_profile_id: Optional second profile. It must differ from main_profile_id.

policy: Every character profile can be selected as the main character.
At most one different profile can be selected as the AI teammate.
Disabling AI teammate ignores the remembered teammate selection.
The launch request is transient and must not change the save schema.
Runtime integration must load the teammate as a read-only companion snapshot without replacing PlayerState.active_profile_id.
AI movement, combat, inventory ownership, death and persistence are gameplay-owned rules.
Character creation UI exposes warrior, wizard and taoist and always requests the fixed male character model. PlayerState creation must validate and create all three professions.
